clue.text: Ornamental plant seen principally in very warm area

indicators.note: in places the picked letter inside the word for very warm

parts.note: very warm means hot

indicators.note: principally points to the leading letter of the word seen

explanation.surface: A gardener notes a decorative plant that thrives mainly in a hot spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'principally' takes S from 'seen'; 'in' puts it inside HOT, and A for area follows.
explanation.definitionFit: The hosta is a leafy perennial grown in gardens for its foliage.

clue.text: Brief stop on journey in the early evening?

indicators.note: brief means cut short, so the last letter goes

parts.note: to halt is to stop
a flight is a journey by air

explanation.surface: A short break on a trip taken at dusk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brief' cuts HALT to HAL; 'on' places it above FLIGHT in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Half-light is the dim light of dusk.

clue.text: Announcement of single Olympic venue

indicators.note: announcement suggests a spoken word, so we hear the synonym for single

parts.note: sole means single or only

explanation.surface: News that a lone Olympic host city has been named.
explanation.walkthrough: SOLE spoken matches the South Korean capital, host of the 1988 Games.
explanation.definitionFit: Seoul hosted the 1988 Summer Olympics.

clue.text: I'm not able to get in beer and port

indicators.note: to get in means one piece is put inside another

parts.note: ale is a beer
I'm not able is I can't

explanation.surface: Someone unable to drink both beer and port wine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Port' looks like the fortified wine, fitting the beer, but means a harbour town.
explanation.definitionFit: Alicante is a Spanish harbour city on the Mediterranean coast.

clue.text: Told about company in recession being moved to new premises

indicators.note: about means the word for told goes around the turned company abbreviation

parts.note: to have told a story is to have related it

indicators.note: in recession means going backwards, so the abbreviation for company is turned round

explanation.surface: A business that shrank during an economic downturn is reported to have moved offices.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in recession' reads the company abbreviation backwards; the economic sense of recession is the misdirection.
explanation.definitionFit: Something relocated has been shifted to a different site or building.

clue.text: Smell smoke

explanation.definitionFit: To stink is to give off a strong odour; in Scots and old English the word also means fumes.

clue.text: Various older stars in this British film

indicators.note: various means the letters of older stars are mixed up in different ways

explanation.surface: A British film featuring veteran actors in its cast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Various' rearranges OLDER STARS. The 2001 film starred older actors such as Michael Caine, and the phrase is also the pub's final call.
explanation.definitionFit: Last Orders is a 2001 British film adapted from Graham Swift's novel.

clue.text: Sailing boat — a clipper?

explanation.definitionFit: A cutter is a single-masted yacht; anything that clips, like shears, is something that cuts.

clue.text: Sanction affected one famous conductor

indicators.note: affected means altered, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: An official penalty had an impact on a well-known maestro.
explanation.walkthrough: 'affected' rearranges the letters of 'Sanction'; the Roman numeral for one is added at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Arturo Toscanini was a celebrated Italian maestro of orchestras.

clue.text: Get lost, Lorna

explanation.walkthrough: DO ONE is everyday British slang for 'clear off'.
explanation.definitionFit: 'Do one' is British slang for go away; Lorna Doone is the heroine of R. D. Blackmore's novel.

clue.text: Wood's fitted into bathrooms? That's crazy

definitions.note: a noun phrase: the quality of being crazy

indicators.note: fitted into means one word is placed inside another, here the timber inside the toilets

parts.note: a loo is British slang for a toilet or bathroom
pine is a wood, and the 's is kept as a letter S

explanation.surface: Someone thinks panelling bathrooms in pine is a mad idea.
explanation.walkthrough: LOO is everyday British for toilet. The definition reads as 'that quality is craziness'.
explanation.definitionFit: Loopy is informal for mad, so loopiness is daftness or eccentricity.

clue.text: Poet's endless chore, note

definitions.note: read as 'poet is', the definition plus a link

indicators.note: endless says the last letter of the word for chore is dropped

parts.note: a chore is a task
SO (or SOH) is a note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A poet complains that a chore never ends, adding a short note.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' cuts TASK to TAS; SO is the fifth note in do-re-mi. The 's on Poet means 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Torquato Tasso was a sixteenth-century Italian writer of epic verse.

clue.text: Woman in love is trouble? Quite the reverse

indicators.note: Quite the reverse tells us to read the whole construction backwards
in tells us one word goes inside the other

parts.note: love means zero in tennis scoring, so nil
to ail is to trouble

explanation.surface: A lovelorn observer says love is just trouble, then takes it back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' makes NAILIL, and 'Quite the reverse' reads that whole run backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Lilian is a female given name.

clue.text: Check speed on way

indicators.note: on in an across clue means the speed word is placed after the way word

parts.note: a mode is a way or method
rate means speed

explanation.surface: Advice to a motorist to watch their pace on the road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Check' looks like a noun but is the verb meaning restrain.
explanation.definitionFit: To moderate is to restrain or temper, which is checking something.

clue.text: With everyone joining together, female's not so happy, being this?

definitions.text: With everyone joining together, female's not so happy, being this?

parts.note: all means everyone
F is the abbreviation for female
lower means less cheerful

explanation.surface: A woman feels down at a dance while everyone else pairs off.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue paints the woman left out at a dance while others couple up.
explanation.definitionFit: A shy person left without a partner at a dance is called this.

clue.text: Wild pig devours small creature, plus a larger one

indicators.note: devours means the scrambled pig swallows the creature, taking it inside
wild signals that the letters of the word pig run riot into a new order

parts.note: the letters of the word, to be rearranged
an ant is a small creature
plus means and

explanation.surface: A wild boar eats a tiny animal and also a bigger beast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wild' turns the letters of 'pig' into GIP, which swallows the insect; 'a larger one' contrasts the panda with the ant.
explanation.definitionFit: The panda is a far bigger animal than the ant, so it is the bigger beast of the two.

clue.text: Poisonous air's clean after treatment

indicators.note: after treatment suggests the letters of air's clean have been processed into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Air that's been treated and cleaned is still toxic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after treatment' rearranges the letters of the clue's own words; the apostrophe adds no letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Arsenical means containing arsenic, a toxic element.

clue.text: Argument that is initially very loud

indicators.note: initially takes the opening letters of the two words before it

parts.note: FF, fortissimo, is the musical marking for very loud

explanation.surface: A quarrel that starts off at full volume.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' takes T and I from 'that is'; FF is the musical mark fortissimo.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiff is a minor quarrel or spat.

clue.text: Not attached to company, Civil War fighter turns up in foreign land

indicators.note: in places the turned name inside the country

parts.note: France is a foreign country from the British setter's view

indicators.note: turns up in a down clue means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: Robert E. Lee was the Confederate general of the American Civil War

explanation.surface: A US Civil War soldier unexpectedly appears overseas, independent of any unit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turns up' reads the general's name upwards in this down clue, making EEL.
explanation.definitionFit: A freelance works independently, hired for jobs without being on a firm's staff.

clue.text: Fresh fish available in tavern a short time

indicators.note: in places the fish inside the tavern

parts.note: an inn is a tavern
the sole is a flatfish
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: Fresh fish on the menu at a pub for a limited time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fresh' looks like describing the fish but means cheeky; 'available' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Fresh can mean cheeky or impudent, as in 'don't get fresh with me'.

clue.text: Shot Raging Bull

indicators.note: raging suggests a wild, furious stirring up of the word Shot's letters

explanation.surface: A film-maker's still of the boxing movie Raging Bull.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Raging' rearranges SHOT. 'Bull' looks like the animal of the film title but means nonsense.
explanation.definitionFit: Bull and tosh are both informal words for nonsense.

clue.text: Italian school's OK about teaching the New Testament

definitions.note: read as 'Italian school is', definition plus a link

indicators.note: about means the word for OK goes around the other pieces

parts.note: OK means fine
lore is a body of teaching or knowledge
NT is the standard abbreviation for the New Testament

explanation.surface: An Italian school is fine with teaching scripture.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's on school means 'is'; the Florentine school was a Renaissance art movement.
explanation.definitionFit: The Florentine school was the Renaissance painting tradition centred on Florence.

clue.text: No fellow in the Air Force fled

indicators.note: in places the pieces inside the air force abbreviation

parts.note: RAF is the Royal Air Force
taken as written

explanation.surface: An airman deserted from the service.
explanation.walkthrough: RAF is the Royal Air Force, Britain's military air service.
explanation.definitionFit: To bolt or escape is to take off quickly.

clue.text: People keep score without use of calculator?

parts.note: men means people
a tally is a running score

explanation.surface: Players keep the score in their heads instead of using a machine.
explanation.definitionFit: Done mentally means worked out in the head, not on a device.

clue.text: Protest for several weeks

explanation.definitionFit: A demonstration is a protest walk; a calendar month spans about four weeks.

clue.text: Nibble small mushroom wraps

indicators.note: wraps means the mushroom word goes around the abbreviation

parts.note: the morel is an edible mushroom

explanation.surface: Someone snacks on a little mushroom wrap.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wraps' puts S inside MOREL. It reads like a food wrap but is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A morsel is a small bite of food.

clue.text: Demonstrated how to squeeze between poles

indicators.note: to squeeze between means a word is pushed in the middle of the two pole letters

parts.note: S and N are the south and north poles

explanation.surface: Someone gave a demonstration of getting through a gap between posts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to squeeze between' puts HOW between S and N, the poles.
explanation.definitionFit: Shown means demonstrated or displayed.

clue.text: Greeting heard up in the mountains?

indicators.note: heard means the greeting is spoken, giving a word with a different spelling

parts.note: hi is a greeting

explanation.surface: A shout of hello echoes in the mountains.
explanation.definitionFit: Mountain peaks are lofty, at great elevation.

clue.text: Partially correct one page

indicators.note: Partially says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A proofreader marks one page as half right.
explanation.definitionFit: A recto is the right-hand page of an open book.

clue.text: Extremely low-sounding record

indicators.note: the sounding suffix tells us the phrase for extremely low is spoken, giving a different spelling

parts.note: right down means as low as can be

explanation.surface: A deep-voiced album by a singer.
explanation.walkthrough: RIGHT DOWN, said aloud, sounds like the two-word phrase for record. 'low-sounding' looks like describing a deep sound.
explanation.definitionFit: To note something on paper is to set it in writing, a record.

clue.text: Offer to speak at length

explanation.surface: Someone offers to give a long speech.
explanation.definitionFit: To proffer something is to extend it; to orate tediously is to declaim on and on.

clue.text: Contract for the future, perhaps

explanation.surface: An agreement for future business.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Contract' looks like a noun for a deal; it is the verb meaning tighten. The future is a grammatical form of the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: Muscles tighten when they contract; the future is one verb form among past and present.
